node.statement: Validated node 1.2.4.1 supplies the previously omitted premise: ZD_0=D_0Z for every Z in B. Independently, for each block M_d, E_ij E_ji=E_ii, so pi(D_d)=(1/d) sum_{i,j} E_ii=sum_i E_ii=I_{M_d}; because multiplication preserves the matching block embedding, pi(D_0)=sum_r iota_r(pi(D_{d_r}))=direct-sum_r I_{M_{d_r}}=I_B. Thus D_0 satisfies both defining conditions in def-fd-cstar-diagonal—centrality from validated node 1.2.4.1 and normalization from this computation—and therefore D_0 is a diagonal.
